01 · VOICE IVR · 08045163666

UPI 123Pay Voice Call

Dials NPCI’s official 08045163666 IVR hotline and sends DTMF tones with recipient phone and whole-rupee value. Works on Jio, Airtel, Vi, and BSNL from ₹1 to ₹4,999.

tel:08045163666,,1,<phone>,,<value>,,1
Architecture & Ground Rules

Every PIN stays inside your bank channel.

Your local transaction log is sealed inside Room + SQLCipher using an Android Keystore master key (Proximity_db_master_key, AES/GCM/NoPadding, 128-bit auth tag). Proximity never uploads history, never acts as a wallet, and never captures your UPI PIN.

  1. Two details at setup. Only your UPI-linked mobile bank name and SIM operator. Zero account numbers or IFSC codes.
  2. Official PIN entry only. Entered strictly inside the carrier USSD pop-up or NPCI voice call, never stored in app memory.
  3. Verify before confirmation. Review merchant or phone number first; bank SMS is read locally only while settlement confirmation arrives.

Eligibility & Governing Law

For users 18+ in India with an active UPI-linked Indian bank account and supporting SIM under the Indian Contract Act (1872), PSS Act (2007), PMLA (2002), and IT Act (2000).

Terms of Service, Disclaimer & Privacy

Last updated: October 4, 2026 · Applicable jurisdiction: India

Setup Disclaimer & Non-Custodial Scope

Proximity is not a bank, wallet, NBFC, or payment processor, and it never holds, pools, moves, or has access to your funds. All Proximity does is initiate official *99# USSD menus, UPI 123Pay IVR calls, and ISP-whitelisted Walled Garden recharge views. Every transaction is authorized and settled directly by you, your bank, NPCI, and your telecom operator. Proximity is not affiliated with or endorsed by NPCI, RBI, any bank, any carrier, or Walled Garden.

1. Acceptance, Eligibility & Aggregator Role

Downloading or using Proximity forms a binding agreement under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Users must be at least 18 years old, reside in India or hold a valid Indian bank account linked to an Indian mobile number, and have USSD/UPI123Pay enabled by their bank and carrier. Proximity commits to compliance with RBI Payment Aggregator guidelines (2020) and stores zero Sensitive Authentication Data (SAD).

2. Data Privacy & Local Storage

Proximity never collects, stores, reads, or transmits your UPI PIN, OTP, MPIN, bank account numbers, IFSC codes, or card details on any Proximity-operated server. Incoming bank SMS messages are read strictly on device during payment confirmation detection and are never uploaded. Use Android biometric or device PIN lock to protect your device.

3. User Responsibilities & Prohibited Uses

Users must verify recipient UPI ID, phone number, QR payee details, recharge amount, and carrier before confirming, and comply with the Information Technology Act (2000), Payment and Settlement Systems Act (2007), RBI circulars, NPCI rules, and PMLA (2002). Reversing or decompiling the proprietary app, bypassing transaction limits, or abusive network usage is strictly prohibited.

4. Warranties, Liability Cap & Dispute Resolution

Provided on an “AS IS” and “AS AVAILABLE” basis without express or implied warranties under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. Developers are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential losses, carrier failures, bank restrictions, or device theft, with maximum aggregate liability capped at INR 500 (paid features) or INR 0 (free features). Disputes are governed by Indian law (Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996); financial transaction grievances must be raised with your bank or https://www.npci.org.in.

5. Intellectual Property, Termination & Contact

The app codebase, UI, graphics, and branding are proprietary (“All rights are reserved”). Uninstalling the app ends usage at any time while liability and survival clauses remain in effect. Contact: anshumanpati411@gmail.com.

1. On-Device Data Architecture

Proximity operates offline-first with no cloud database or Proximity-hosted analytics server. Your selected bank name, SIM preference, and payment records stay exclusively on your device inside Room + SQLCipher encrypted with an Android Keystore key (Proximity_db_master_key, AES/GCM/NoPadding).

2. Zero Sensitive Authentication Data (SAD)

Proximity never collects, stores, intercepts, or transmits UPI PINs, MPINs, OTPs, full bank account numbers, IFSC codes, or card details. Authentication happens strictly inside your carrier’s *99# USSD flow or NPCI’s official 123Pay voice channel.

3. Android Permissions Breakdown

Phone permissions (CALL_PHONE, READ_PHONE_STATE, MANAGE_OWN_CALLS, ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS) initiate and manage official 123Pay / *99# sessions. RECEIVE_SMS listens strictly for incoming bank settlement notices during active payments; READ_SMS is deliberately omitted so historical messages are never read. CAMERA and READ_CONTACTS run offline on device for UPI QR scanning and recipient selection.

4. Website Storage & Deletion

This website uses zero third-party advertising cookies or analytics trackers. Only your theme choice (proximity-theme) and optional beta request preview (proximity-waitlist-request) are saved locally in browser storage. Uninstalling the Android app or tapping Clear App Data in Settings erases local app records. For privacy questions, email anshumanpati411@gmail.com.
